lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe King WaitsNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 26BETROTHAL BROKEN OFF: SCANDINAVIAN COURT SILENTYou did not get the photograph, and you did not tell the King. By the end of April he has heard the rest from a quarter that he has no reason to trust, and the betrothal is broken off by the Scandinavian court in a note of eleven lines. The King does not blame you in public. In private he says that he had thought you the cleverest man in Europe, and the sentence is carried to you by three separate people.
